drafts.walkScript: Look at stam_ and _ond. One letter must end stam_ and start _ond. The letter p makes stamp and pond. With b, bond works but stamb does not. With a, neither word works.
Look at crow_ and _est. One letter must end crow_ and start _est. An n makes crown and nest. With d, crowd works but dest does not. With b, best works but crowb does not.
Look at spoo_ and _oise. One letter must end spoo_ and start _oise. An n makes spoon and noise. With f, spoof works but foise does not. With p, poise works but spoop does not.
Look at chal_ and _ing. One letter must end chal_ and start _ing. The letter k makes chalk and king. With b, chalb is not a word. With a, neither word works.
Look at gree_ and _oise. One letter must end gree_ and start _oise. An n makes green and noise. With d, greed works but doise does not. With p, poise works but greep does not.
Look at grou_ and _ip. One letter must end grou_ and start _ip. The letter p makes group and pip. With d, dip works but groud does not. With a, neither word works.
